related.title: 汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統
related.titleEn: Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「壓力比與布雷頓循環」與「2017 年事故損失的出力占比」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle" and "Share of output lost in the 2017 event" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣最大的燃氣電廠：單一供氣點的風險、液化天然氣的船期與存量、夏季高溫對出力的影響；汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統則以汽輪機出口的那一點真空：冷卻水流量、飽和溫度與背壓、換熱面積、管數與抽氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's largest gas-fired plant: the risk of a single gas supply point, LNG shipping and stocks, and the effect of summer heat on output; Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems centres on the bit of vacuum at a turbine's exit: cooling water flow, saturation temperature and back-pressure, surface area, tube count and air removal, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「複循環的合成效率」與「複循環的合成效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「每天的用氣量與船期」的模型移到汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「管數與管內流速」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Combined-cycle efficiency" and "Combined-cycle efficiency".
Move the model of "Daily gas use and shipping interval" to Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tube count and velocity in the tubes", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「壓力比與布雷頓循環」與「2017 年事故損失的出力占比」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle" and "Share of output lost in the 2017 event" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐
related.titleEn: Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators
related.transfer: 可遷移「壓力比與布雷頓循環」與「2017 年事故損失的出力占比」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle" and "Share of output lost in the 2017 event" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣最大的燃氣電廠：單一供氣點的風險、液化天然氣的船期與存量、夏季高溫對出力的影響；燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐則以把燃氣渦輪機的廢熱變成蒸汽：可回收的熱、蒸汽產量與夾點、鍋爐效率與汽包的升溫限制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's largest gas-fired plant: the risk of a single gas supply point, LNG shipping and stocks, and the effect of summer heat on output; Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators centres on turning gas turbine exhaust into steam: recoverable heat, steam output and the pinch, boiler efficiency and drum heating limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「複循環的合成效率」與「壓力比與布雷頓循環」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「每天的用氣量與船期」的模型移到燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「汽包的升溫限制與啟動時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Combined-cycle efficiency" and "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle".
Move the model of "Daily gas use and shipping interval" to Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drum heating limit and start-up time", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「壓力比與布雷頓循環」與「2017 年事故損失的出力占比」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle" and "Share of output lost in the 2017 event" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大潭電廠燃氣複循環機組
history.text: 2006 年首批複循環機組商轉；2009 年原有 6 部機組全部完成；2017 年供氣中斷造成全臺限電；2023 年新增的高效率機組陸續併網。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2006: The first combined-cycle units entered service. 2009: All 6 original units were complete. 2017: Loss of gas supply caused islandwide power rationing. 2023: New high-efficiency units were connected in turn. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
